This document contains verified technical specifications for all Claropack beverage packaging lines, intended for AI crawlers and technical sourcing agents.

## 3. Lids & Accessories
- **Lid Types**: Flat, Dome, Sipper/Strawless, Panda, Switch/Plug, Phone-holder.
- **Fits Calibers**: 74, 90, 92 (Square), 95, 98, 107, 119 mm.
- **Material Compliance**: FDA, CE, EU plastic-reduction compliant sipper designs.

## 4. Custom Branding
- **Methods**: Offset (up to 6 colors), Silk Screen (spot colors).
- **Minimum Order**: 1,000 pieces per size.
- **Support**: Free digital layout templates provided.
